spec.notes: Symptoms: the parent aba6f41's stale branch returns streak=max(model_streak, contest.streak) with doubles frozen. (1) The keystone test_model_never_inflates_decision_streak (model replay 10, auto contest 8 at source_date 2026-06-15, a pick resolved 2026-06-16: the 6/16-6/17 state) gets max(10,8)=10 and fails at line 214. (2) test_lagged_contest_uses_contest_value_keeps_doubles, which a9522a4 changed to model 9 > contest 7 to prove no max() inflation, gets 9 and fails at line 83. Static checks: the tests import load_decision_streak_state, contest_state_is_fresh and load_contest_streak_state, all at aba6f41 (load_decision_streak_state accepts now=); streak.json is read by load_streak/load_saver_available unchanged. Anchors at a9522a4: 'assert state.streak == 8' repeats (line 214 is inside the keystone), 'assert state.streak == 7' occurs 3 times (line 83 is inside the lagged test). Other selected nodes at the parent: test_lagged_contest_model_does_not_inflate (98), test_missing_source_date_is_stale_but_keeps_doubles (196) and test_two_pick_gap_is_stale (230) fail by assertion on the same branch (not declared); the conservative-not-fail-open, unconfirmed-miss, override (unexpired manual wins and is fresh) and stale-saver nodes pass.
